name: July 2026 tightening-market override
purpose: Market inverted from May compression to supply-driven tightening. Dry van spot at record highs, spot above contract (first since Feb 2022), linehaul +39% YoY, capacity contracting. Bid posture shifts from defensive acceptance to floor protection and urgency-premium capture.
authorityRule: True RPM remains the calculation authority. Do not import national dry-van gains 1:1 into cargo-van bids; Midwest-to-Midwest lanes lag national (+10-15% YoY). Broker urgency and repost behavior justify firmer counters than in H1.

shortLocalOrReposition.note: Urgency premiums rising; bid/call fast, counter high first.

mediumFeeder.note: Sub-1.40 acceptance is now positional-only, no longer a market default. Counter toward floor before conceding.

midLengthRecovery.note: Tier 1/Tier 2 destination still required for the low end.

longDisplacement.note: Weak-destination long-locks require premium; capacity scarcity is negotiating leverage.

extremeLongLock.note: Westbound/border/rural must clear premium; do not discount into displacement.

MidwestCore.rule: MW-MW up only 10-15% YoY vs +39% national linehaul. Protect 1.40 floor; do not chase national headlines on intra-Midwest lanes.

Northeast.rule: Worst route-guide failure region nationally. Inbound NE justifies premium asks; verify cargo-van clearing on board before anchoring to dry-van data.

KansasCity.rule: Unchanged: prioritize north/east reloads toward STL/Chicago/Indiana/Ohio.

MinnesotaTwinCities.rule: Escape discounts toward Chicago/Indiana/Ohio no longer automatic; test floor bids first.

hardRejects: Any load under 0.90 True RPM unless data is wrong
Trap destination without premium or clear exit plan
Heavy cargo-van freight without payload verification
Stale pickup/delivery timing unless broker confirms corrected live appointment
